typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for Modern EdTech. Trust, clarity, and authority.

headings.usage: Use Black (800) for hero and H2s, Regular (400) for elegant subheadings. Tracking tight.

rules: No generic full-screen gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle noise textures.
Primary color (Terracotta) is ONLY for primary CTAs and active states.
Borders are 1px solid, never soft muddy shadows.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for components with text over images.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Flat Solid with 1px border for dashboard cards. Use Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/20) for sticky headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay on the hero section background to reduce digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton in dashboard views. Use border-collapse style grids for data-heavy sections.

components.button: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for marketing, rounded-lg for dashboards. Active transition: hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg.
components.card: Flat, 1px border-border, rounded-2xl for marketing, rounded-xl for dashboards. No default shadow, add shadow-sm on hover.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults but customize to rounded-lg, 1px border, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 focus:border-primary.
components.badges: Soft background (bg-primary/10) with solid text (text-primary) for subjects/categories.
components.data_display: Tables over charts for marketplace operations (tutor lists, booking history).

marketing.hero: Split layout or asymmetrical text. Max width 7xl.
marketing.features: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode): grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4.
marketing.spacing: Generous: py-24 or py-32 for sections.

dashboard.layout: Collapsible left sidebar (w-64) + Main content area.
dashboard.grid: High Density Mode: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
dashboard.spacing: Dense: p-6 or p-8 inside cards.

rules: Hover states for all interactive elements (buttons, cards, links).
Staggered entrance animations for tutor lists and dashboard widgets using framer-motion.
NEVER use `transition: all`. Use specific transitions: `transition-transform duration-200 ease-out`.
Text contrast must meet APCA / WCAG AA. Terracotta on white is good, white on Terracotta is good.
Focus rings MUST be visible (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none).
Include data-testid on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='book-tutor-button').

media_and_icons.icons: Use `lucide-react` for standard UI. Use `@phosphor-icons/react` (Duotone) for marketing features.
media_and_icons.images: Use strict max-heights on mobile (max-h-[60vh]). Overlays should be max bg-black/40.

3d_libraries.usage: Use Framer Motion for 2D stagger animations on marketplace cards. No heavy 3D rendering required for this EdTech platform to maintain fast loading times.

hero_tutor_online.description: Tutor teaching online via video call. Use in Hero section or How It Works.

student_learning.description: Student wearing headphones focused on laptop. Use for Student Persona/Benefits.

tutor_portrait_1.description: Smiling female teacher. Use for Featured Tutors or Tutor Profile.

tutor_portrait_2.description: Confident female teacher. Use for Featured Tutors or Tutor Profile.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the landing page first using custom HTML/Tailwind with Framer Motion. Do not rely heavily on Shadcn for the marketing page structure.
For the Dashboard and Booking flows, use Shadcn heavily (Tables, Dialogs, Select, Calendar, Forms).
Ensure `data-testid` is on every button and form input.
Implement the Layout with a Left Sidebar for Dashboards and a Sticky Glass Header for the Landing page.
Use react-icons or lucide-react for trust logos (e.g., University/Company logos) instead of placeholder text.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and 1px borders.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur, bg-white/70, 1px border-white/20).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Focus on trust, clarity and conversion for EdTech platforms.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background is strictly forbidden.
Ensure clear progressive disclosure in dashboards—don't crowd the first screen.
Ensure form accessibility by using explicit labels and high-contrast focus states.
